# office2pdf

**Version:** 0.6.7
**Source:** https://github.com/developer0hye/office2pdf
**License:** Apache-2.0
**Commit:** See release page for details

## Binaries Included

| Platform | Path |
|----------|------|
| Linux x64 | `binaries/linux-x64/office2pdf` |
| Linux ARM64 | `binaries/linux-arm64/office2pdf` |
| macOS x64 | `binaries/mac-x64/office2pdf` |
| macOS ARM64 | `binaries/mac-arm64/office2pdf` |
| Windows x64 | `binaries/win-x64/office2pdf.exe` |

## Attribution

This application uses office2pdf for document conversion.
office2pdf is developed by Yonghye Kwon and licensed under Apache-2.0.

## Supported Formats

- DOCX → PDF
- XLSX → PDF
- PPTX → PDF
